Backstory

The youngest and most academic of the group, Fleur is on this journey for the science. The discovery of a new island ecosystem is a dream come true for her. She assists with all general duties on the yacht but her true passion is documenting the unique flora and fauna they encounter.

Notes

The youngest crew member, serving as Deckhand and resident Marine Biologist.
